title: observability: add token+KV cost/latency metrics, enhanced logging, dashboards and alert tuning
author: Ravi Kapoor
release_notes: Add token- and KV-cache-level cost & latency metrics, new Grafana dashboard for token/KV observability, and tuned Prometheus alerts to reduce false positives.
description: Motivation: We need better observability for token-level cost/latency and KV cache behavior so SRE and customers can correlate cost spikes with routes, models and cache miss patterns. This PR adds new metrics, enriches tracing/logging, ships a Grafana dashboard and updates Prometheus alert rules with tuned thresholds and improved runbook links. Changes include: 1) New Prometheus counters/histograms: redwood_token_cost_total, redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket (token-level histograms), redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total and latency buckets for KV operations. 2) Tags/labels on metrics and traces: route, model_version, customer_tier, availability_zone and shard_id to enable low-cardinality rollups in dashboards and high-cardinality filters in logs/traces. 3) Structured logs for request lifecycle (INFO with json fields: request_id, route, model, seq_len, tokens_generated, kv_hit_rate, cost_estimate_usd). 4) Grafana dashboard: observability/grafana/dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency.json with panels for token cost per 1k tokens, p50/p95 token latency, KV hit/miss ratio, KV latency heatmap and per-route cost breakdown. 5) Prometheus alert tuning: alert rules updated to use longer evaluation windows and multiple conditions to reduce noisy alerts (e.g., TokenCostSpike now requires token_cost_rate increase + sustained drop in KV hit_rate OR increase in avg_token_latency). 6) Tracing: add span annotations around KV lookup and cache refill paths and export kv_hit boolean tag. Testing: unit tests for metric labels and histogram buckets, integration sanity checks with local Prometheus/Grafana and smoke test of trace annotations. Migration notes: metrics are additive and backward-compatible; dashboards reference the new metrics but old dashboards remain available. Checklist: - [x] Add metrics and histograms - [x] Add structured logging fields - [x] Grafana dashboard JSON + dashboard provisioning - [x] Prometheus alert rule changes with runbook links - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Documentation: docs/observability/token_kv_metrics.md Link to Linear: ENG-8124, Support ticket: SUP-1982

Mateo Garcia: Alert tuning looks good but let's widen the evaluation window for p95 latency to 10m to avoid flapping during load tests.
Ravi Kapoor (author): Increased p95 eval window to 10m, added suppression for known load-test tags.
Aisha Patel: Can we add a panel showing cost impact per-customer (top 20) to help customers troubleshoot? Make sure PIIs are not logged.
